scope: Category A of originals-catalog.md: success cases whose original (or registered viewing preview / page) Claude can open in this repository, with the SHA-256 of each file computed from the committed bytes. Read by scripts/design-artifact/case-study-check.ts (lib/design-agent/case-study/case-study.ts). Does not change manifest.json or second-root-research-successes.json (the ledgers stay the source of truth for counts and policy).

rules.counts_as_reference: Only an original with counts_as_reference true counts toward the 3 originals a shop's case study needs (docs/design/image-first-production-flow.md §1 stage 1, §3.1). SR-001 is viewable but never counts: second-root-research-successes.json policy, a fictional shop's own page is not a reference for other shops.
rules.private_original_ids: Category B ids whose original is not in this repository. A case study counts one only when it marks the case private_verified, lists the private file(s) outside the repository by absolute path and SHA-256, the checker finds each file with that SHA-256, and at least one file's SHA-256 is recorded for that id: manifest.json's sha256 fields (rejected / not-preferred revisions excluded) for CP-004..024, expected_sha256 below for SR-002 and CP-033..037. A cited .zip must match a recorded SHA-256 and the viewed images must be listed with it. The owner confirms on the viewing page.
rules.expected_sha256: From the adoption records: SR-002 the approved PNG (PR #237), CP-033 the adopted ZIP (PR #240), CP-034..037 the adopted ZIPs (Issue #193, originals-catalog.md).
rules.unavailable_ids: Category C: only candidate file names, no recorded SHA-256; never counted until the original is found and recorded.
rules.never_counted: SR-001 never counts (also hard-coded in the checker).
rules.copy: A file marked copy: "viewing" is a viewing copy derived from the original (downscaled / recompressed / possibly cropped WebP), not the original, and it is never called an original: the whole-page prompt and the case-study viewing page name it a viewing copy (DEV-364, owner decision 2026-11-27). The marker does not change the counting rule above (counts_as_reference is unchanged). Whether viewing copies may count toward the 3 originals beyond the owner's one-time exception for req-hoshigama-wp-01 (a fictional shop) is pending the owner's decision. CP-001..003's original PNG / source ZIP are not in this repository (docs/design/success-originals-handover.md).
rules.zip_member_originals: DEV-364 (PR #381 review H1): the members of adopted success ZIPs (originals-handover.json role success_zip) that ARE the original — only the final adopted full pages (PC and SP), each checked by eye on 2026-11-27 — by member path, member SHA-256 and the ZIP SHA-256 they must come from. A case-study file marked zip_member counts as an original only when it is listed here and verifyZipMembers confirms it inside that ZIP and its SHA256SUMS; any other member (sheets, overviews, comparisons, first views, intermediate versions) stays evidence only. Hashes and paths only; no image is in the repository. CP-034..036 are not listed yet (their adopted full pages have not been checked).

originals.not_counted_reason: second-root-research-successes.json policy: a fictional shop's own Second Root page, not a reference for other shops
